svg.title: ZORINDEX workflow: documents, sketches, merge groups and filters
svg.desc: Four document objects contain representative k-mers. Mergeable sketch objects provide Jaccard estimates: D1 and D2 have similarity one half. The merge plan groups D1 and D2 and leaves D3 and D4 separate. A filter is constructed for each group after planning; equal-capacity filters are packed into power-of-two subindexes, with optional abandoned keys in one global 32-bit-hash multimap. Grids are schematic, not actual solved cells or cardinality-derived capacities. GATCA probes every subindex and the auxiliary map. Filter hits contribute D1, the map contributes D4, and the combined document result is 1,0,0,1. Selected slices are blue. No hierarchical query traversal or bitwise merging of old arrays is implied.
